# Crazy Picnics

> > Your complete guide to picnic spots, weekend getaways, and tourist attractions around Mumbai and Maharashtra, India.

Crazy Picnics specializes in travel guides for day trips, weekend escapes, and tourist destinations primarily in Mumbai and surrounding Maharashtra regions. The site covers beaches, hill stations, adventure activities, cultural sites, and practical travel information for visitors exploring Western India.

## Key Topics

- Mumbai tourism
- Maharashtra travel destinations
- Weekend getaways from Mumbai
- Picnic spots near Mumbai
- Hill stations (Igatpuri, Mahabaleshwar)
- Beach destinations (Alibaug, Tarkarli, Revdanda)
- Adventure activities and water sports
- Sanjay Gandhi National Park
- One-day trips from Mumbai
- Pune region attractions
- Konkan coast tourism
- Sahyadri mountain range
- Mumbai sightseeing
- Pilgrimage sites (Shirdi)
- Wildlife sanctuaries (Tadoba)

## Essential Mumbai Tourist Attractions

- [Best Place to visit in Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/08/best-place-to-visit-in-mumbai.html): Top tourist attractions in Mumbai including Essel World and Sanjay Gandhi Park
- [Picnic Spot Near Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/10/picnic-spot-near-mumbai.html): One-day picnic spots near Mumbai including Essel World and Sanjay Gandhi Park
- [Global Vipassana Pagoda Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/10/global-vipassana-pagoda-mumbai.html): Global Vipassana Pagoda meditation center in Gorai, Mumbai
- [Film City Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/10/film-city-mumbai.html): Film City Mumbai Bollywood studio complex in Goregaon East
- [Hanging Gardens Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/11/hanging-gardens-mumbai.html): Hanging Gardens terraced park on Malabar Hill with sunset views
- [Fashion Street Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/11/fashion-street-mumbai.html): Fashion Street Mumbai budget shopping market near CST and Marine Lines
- [Smaaash Junior Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/12/smaaash-junior-mumbai.html): Smaaash Junior kids entertainment zone in Lower Parel, Mumbai

## Weekend Getaways and Hill Stations

- [Igatpuri weekend gateway near by Mumbai](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/09/igatpuri-weekend-gateway-near-by-mumbai.html): Igatpuri hill station weekend getaway from Mumbai and Pune with trekking
- [Best Places to Visit in Mahabaleshwar Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2024/06/best-places-to-visit-in-mahabaleshwar.html): Mahabaleshwar hill station viewpoints and waterfalls sightseeing guide
- [Pawna Lake Camping Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/11/pawna-lake-camping-maharashtra.html): Pawna Lake camping near Lonavala - weekend picnic spot from Mumbai/Pune
- [Durshet Khapoli Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/08/durshet-khapoli-maharashtra.html): Durshet village weekend getaway with river rafting and adventure activities
- [Kalsubai Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/08/kalsubai-maharashtra.html): Kalsubai peak trekking guide - highest mountain in Maharashtra at 5400 feet

## Beach Destinations

- [Alibaug Beach Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/09/alibaug-maharashtra.html): Alibaug beach destination on Konkan coast - 2 hours from Mumbai
- [Tarkarli Beach Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/09/tarkarli-beach-maharashtra.html): Tarkarli Beach in Malvan with scuba diving and water sports activities
- [Revdanda Beach Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/11/revdanda-beach-maharashtra.html): Revdanda Beach near Mumbai with Portuguese fort and St. Francis Xavier site

## Pilgrimage and Cultural Sites

- [Shirdi Sai Baba Temple Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/09/shirdi-sai-baba-temple-maharashtra.html): Shirdi Sai Baba Temple pilgrimage guide in Ahmednagar, Maharashtra
- [Sula Wine in Nashik Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2018/09/wine-taste-in-nashik.html): Sula Vineyards wine tasting tour in Nashik with 50 wineries

## Wildlife and Nature

- [Tadoba National Park Maharashtra](https://www.crazypicnics.com/2019/09/tadoba-national-park-maharashtra.html): Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve safari booking in Chandrapur, Maharashtra
